render_policy_to_graph: render an AgentFlow policy into an intermediate subgraph node representation
add_custom_renderer: add a custom renderer function for a new AgentFlow node type
convert_sequence_to_graph: convert a Sequence policy with child options into a graph with success and failure edges
convert_conditional_to_graph: convert a conditional policy with true and false branches into a graph
convert_concurrent_to_graph: convert a ConcurrentOption policy with parallel child options into a graph
